review.title: Review of Magnetic Tunnel Junctions for Stochastic Computing
review.titleZh: 用于随机计算的磁隧道结综述
review.authors: B. R. Zink, Y. Lv, J.-P. Wang
review.venue: IEEE Journal on Exploratory Solid-State Computational Devices and Circuits 8 (2022)
review.assistantSummary: 系统梳理MTJ热激活随机翻转、概率位、随机数与非布尔计算，并讨论能垒、偏压、温度和器件分布如何决定概率曲线。
review.whySelected: 能帮助把今日300 mm SOT-MRAM的0.1%写噪声与10% D2D区分为可利用随机性和不可接受工艺变异。
readingGuide: 再看热稳定因子与偏压/温度
整理概率曲线斜率、相关性和能耗
最后对照晶圆级分布；50–70分钟

classics.title: Dependence of Giant Tunnel Magnetoresistance of Sputtered CoFeB/MgO/CoFeB Magnetic Tunnel Junctions on MgO Barrier Thickness and Annealing Temperature
classics.titleZh: 溅射CoFeB/MgO/CoFeB经典：MgO厚度、375 °C退火与260%室温TMR
classics.authors: Jun Hayakawa, Shoji Ikeda, Fumihiro Matsukura, Hiromasa Takahashi, Hideo Ohno
classics.venue: Japanese Journal of Applied Physics 44, L587–L589 (2005)
classics.assistantSummary: 在SiO2/Si上溅射CoFeB/MgO/CoFeB，MgO 1.15–2.4 nm范围RA随厚度指数增长；375 °C退火使原本非晶CoFeB形成晶态结构，TMR达室温260%、5 K 403%。
classics.whySelected: 把势垒厚度、RA、结晶和跨温TMR连成至今仍适用的工艺基线。
